description: This file provides utility functions for encrypting and decrypting tenant/organization identifiers using AES-128-ECB encryption with crypto-js. It includes functions for validating salts, deriving encryption keys, and performing encryption/decryption operations, specifically tailored for tenant ID security within a web application.

methods.name: isUrlSafeShortBase64
methods.description: Validates that a string appears to be URL-safe base64 without padding, with length approximately 22-24 characters.

methods.name: deriveAes128KeyFromBase64UrlSalt
methods.description: Derives a 16-byte AES key from a base64url-encoded salt by decoding, hashing with SHA-256, and taking the first 16 bytes.

methods.name: removeBase64Padding
methods.description: Removes '=' padding characters from a base64 string.

methods.name: isTenantSaltValid
methods.description: Checks if the tenant salt appears to be valid URL-safe base64 without padding.

methods.name: encryptTenantId
methods.description: Encrypts a tenant ID string using AES-128-ECB with a key derived from the validated tenant salt, returning a base64 string without padding.

methods.name: decryptTenantId
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted tenant ID string (base64 without padding) back to the original tenant ID.
